title: Badla Naag Ka
desc: A fearless man hurts a snake when it tries to attack his lover. Later, he tries to protect himself from the snake which is trying to exact its revenge.

title: Odela Railway Station
desc: IPS Officer, Anudeep takes charge as he investigates a series of murders and a whole other conspiracy linked with ritual killing.

title: Bengal Tiger
desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

title: Pralay the Destroyer
desc: Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.

title: Ginna
desc: Ginna leads a simple life and makes a living by running a tent house in his village. However, he has huge debts and all his hopes to repay the debts dry up.

title: Main Hoon Rakhwala
desc: A loyal servant is imprisoned for murdering his employer's wife. However, a shocking revelation unfolds after the servant is released from prison.
